SHIPPED: Complete exercise system redesign for Negotiation Trainer iOS app
SIGNIFICANCE: Replaced generic drill containers with technique-specific sub-skill exercises. ~75% of exercises now evaluate locally (no LLM). Duolingo-style progression: classify → highlightWords → wordBankBuilder → fillTemplate → sequenceOrder → transform → construct.
KEY PATTERN: Recognition first (no LLM), then scaffolded production, then free text. Each level unlocks after mastering previous.
FILES CREATED (~19): ExerciseType.swift, Exercise.swift, ExerciseResult.swift, ExerciseResponse.swift, LocalEvaluator.swift, SDExerciseResult.swift, ExerciseBank.swift + ExerciseBank+Voss.swift + ExerciseBank+MI.swift + ExerciseBank+Cialdini.swift, ExerciseSessionViewModel.swift, ExerciseSessionView.swift, 7 per-type views, WordChipView.swift, ExerciseFlowLayout.swift
CONTENT: 40 Voss + 31 MI + 22 Cialdini = ~93 exercises across 21 techniques
ENABLES: Content expansion (add JSON per framework), old drill system cleanup
